Title: Generally available: ContainerLogV2 Schema in Azure Monitor container insights

Body.Content:
ContainerLogV2 also supports the Basic Logs, a low-cost alternative to the standard Log Analytics pricing. Customers can now get the same drill-in querying experience in the portal as before at a reduced cost.

The new ContainerLogV2 schema offers a streamlined querying experience, reducing the data to a single table, reducing the number of required join operations.

  • Spend less time writing and editing KQL with the reduced query complexity
  • Troubleshoot your container logs more quickly with faster queries
  • Support for the low-cost Basic Logs plan

Basic Logs offer a low-cost alternative to the standard analytics logs, with the Container Insights integration, customers can now receive the full feature parity with drill-in functionality through the Container Insights portal experience.

Learn More:

  • Container Insights Docs on ContainerLogv2: https://aka.ms/ContainerLogv2
  • Container Insights Docs on Basic Logs: https://aka.ms/CIBasicLogs
  • Basic Logs setup: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/basic-logs-configure                                                           
  • Pricing comparison: https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/
